codeReview.summary: Core Engine/AgentType/DroidActivity additions and required tests were implemented, but the feature did not satisfy the explicit requirement to add Droid arms to all Engine match expressions across the codebase.

issues.description: Engine match for jsonl_path still uses a catchall (`_ => PathBuf::from(PENDING_DISCOVERY)`) instead of an explicit `Engine::Droid` arm, so not all Engine matches include Droid as required.
Second jsonl_path Engine match in add_pane_with_engine still uses a catchall instead of an explicit `Engine::Droid` arm, violating the feature requirement to update all Engine match expressions.

`strip_tui_chrome` matches on Engine with `Engine::Codex` plus `_` catchall; this was not updated to include an explicit `Engine::Droid` arm despite the requirement to add Droid arms to all Engine matches.

sharedStateObservations.observation: The mission AGENTS.md explicitly says to avoid `_ =>` catchall arms for Engine/AgentType matches, but this feature preserved Engine catchalls and treated that as acceptable. This suggests enforcement is missing (rule is documented but not guarded by checks).
sharedStateObservations.evidence: Mission AGENTS.md: "No `_ =>` catchall arms for Engine or AgentType matches"; handoff verification notes "include Droid arm or use _ catchall where appropriate"; code still has catchalls at src/wagner.rs:91,603 and src/transport/telegram/mod.rs:2541.

sharedStateObservations.observation: rust-worker procedure requires RED-first (write failing tests before implementation), but transcript shows implementation edits occurred before adding tests, and no failing-test phase was recorded.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: Transcript skeleton sequence: multiple Edit calls across src/* first, then later "Step 11: Write tests" and only then validator runs.

summary: Review failed: while primary Droid model/status additions and tests are present, explicit Droid arms were not added to all Engine match expressions as required.
